methodology: Independent production builds, original warm-up state (lazy loaded, input filled, one reversal, portal toggled). Five alternating fresh-context blocks; five warm-up and twenty measured batches of twenty flushSync updates, plus twenty actual clicks. Instrumentation builds are excluded from timing; diagnostic counts are per one update. Generated fixtures are ignored under test-results/investigation.
